record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly increase hidden width from 64 to 96 and dropout from 0.15 to 0.20. Greater capacity may capture more item relationships, while stronger dropout limits overfitting on short histories. Retain learning rate 8e-4, six causal blocks, kernel size 3, history length 64 and batch size 128. Preserve features, embedding tying, interaction and readout formulas, loss, optimizer, seed 42, and the 200-epoch/200-batch limits; synchronize predictor shapes.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four categories, increase hidden width from 64 to 96 and dropout from 0.15 to 0.20. Added capacity may capture more item relationships, while stronger dropout limits overfitting. Existing metadata and predictor reconstruction propagate the trained width automatically. Preserve all other hyperparameters, features, loss, causal backbone, routing and single-checkpoint inference.
